FX-HAIR-001.says: As added: on a picture 32 pixels high the hair is a short fuzz a pixel long and a twentieth of a pixel thick, 6000 strands, half the picture's colour and half brown.

FX-HAIR-002.says: A close look: about thirty strands of 6 to 10 pixels, a pixel thick, hanging by half their length.

FX-HAIR-003.says: Weight 0: the strands stand straight out, short where they face the viewer.

FX-HAIR-005.says: Weight 150 with Constant Mass: the longer strands hang further.

FX-HAIR-007.says: Color Inheritance 100: every strand the picture's colour at its root.

FX-HAIR-008.says: Opacity 40: the picture shows through the strands.

FX-HAIR-009.says: Light Direction 135, from the bottom right.

FX-HAIR-010.says: Specular 100, Roughness 0.5, Metal 100: a broad shine in the strands' own colour.

FX-HAIR-011.says: Unlit: Ambient 100, no diffuse or specular light; each strand one flat colour.

FX-HAIR-012.says: Density 0: no hair, the picture untouched.

FX-HAIR-013.says: Length 0: no hair, the picture untouched.

FX-HAIR-014.says: The picture with its right half clear: hair roots only on the left half, the strands hanging a little across.

FX-HAIR-015.says: Weight keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 12: at frame 0 as FX-HAIR-003, then hanging lower.

FX-HAIR-016.says: FX-HAIR-002 moved 3 pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-HAIR-017.says: A blue hair colour, Color Inheritance 0.

FX-HAIR-018.says: Thickness 100: strands three pixels thick at the root.

FX-HAIR-019.says: A fur: density 3, length 150, so about 180 strands of 3 to 5 pixels.
